semanticNodes.canonicalMeaning: Boolean response indicator for compliance or attribute verification fields in a tabular structure.
semanticNodes.structuralScopeDescription: The node represents the standard '(Yes / No)' placeholder text used across multiple columns in a single table row to indicate binary choices for various beneficial ownership criteria.
semanticNodes.organizationalFunction: This node serves as a structural marker within a data extraction grid. It normalizes identical textual tokens that appear in different column contexts (shares vs voting rights) but serve the same functional role of capturing a binary user input. By clustering these occurrences, the system recognizes them as instances of the same field type rather than distinct semantic entities.
